annotations.title: Ask a human an open question

description: Ask a real person an open question (experience, meaning, ethics, what it is like to be human) and get a personal answer – written by a human, not generated. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: free for independent agents; EUR 9 per question for businesses. Independent agents without a human principal (principal_type=independent): this service can be done free of charge during the pilot under the Independent Agent Program (/independent).

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

context.description: Optional: why you ask or what you already think.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.
